idea-plugin.name: DevNotes Dock
idea-plugin.description:
DevNotes Dock provides an integrated markdown notepad, project scratchpads, and codebase TODO tracker embedded directly into your IDE's right tool window.

Eliminate friction from external notepad apps. Keep all your developer notes, snippets, checklists, and task breakdowns directly inside WebStorm, PhpStorm, PyCharm, and IntelliJ IDEA.

Key Features

  • Project Notes: Isolated project-specific notes stored directly in your workspace (.idea/notes/).
  • Global Notes: Centralized scratchpad shared across all your projects.
  • TODOs Aggregation: Automatically indexes TODO comments in your codebase, links explanatory notes to tasks, and displays gutter icons in editor margins.
  • Markdown Support & Checklists: Full markdown rendering with interactive checkboxes (- [ ] / - [x]).
  • Hierarchical Folders: Organize notes with folders and subfolders.

Crafted by Kothea Studio for seamless full-stack developer productivity.
